critical_code_review_comments: competitor_routes.py grew from 638 → 941 lines. Strongly recommend splitting into competitor_products.py / competitor_matching.py / competitor_scan.py / competitor_apply.py for maintainability.

apply-price endpoint (line 713) does 5 sequential steps with nested try/except returning 200 on business errors — consider returning 4xx for user-actionable errors ('İkas ID bulunamadı', 'variant not found') so the frontend can distinguish transport errors vs domain errors.

apply-all-recommendations (_run_apply_all, line 871) currently just flips 'applied=true' without actually calling the İkas GraphQL mutation — the comment '# Real İkas update would go here' indicates this is a stub. Bulk-apply will NOT update İkas prices; only single apply-price does. HIGH severity gap for Module 4 promise.
price-changes-full aggregation runs plain find without indexes on price_changes.changed_at — for a real production dataset this will slow down; add compound index (applied, changed_at DESC).

auto-match _run_single_product_match writes cheapest_competitor_price to products collection but does NOT create a corresponding price_changes log entry — so Module 5 will remain empty even after successful competitor scans until scan-all path is used (which does write price_changes). Consider unifying logging.
PriceChangesPage.js uses `<td colSpan={7}>` empty-state row but the table header has 7 columns; visually the empty message spans full width but is not vertically centered on tall viewports — minor.

Frontend PriceChangesPage does not currently paginate the header count ('X kayıt') per filter; when a filter is applied, `total` reflects filtered total which is correct, but the wording could be clearer.
